artistSummaries.description: Four light-skinned adult men pose indoors in front of dark worn wood wall paneling and a large framed mirror, with red upholstered seating along the wall. The most prominent figure stands near center in a gray suit and dark brimmed hat, holding a tall silver candlestick with a lit candle. At left, a man in a black fuzzy hat, black blazer, black shirt, and light trousers stands angled with a neutral expression. Behind and right of center, a slimmer man with shaggy blond hair wears a black jacket over a red shirt and dark trousers. At far right, a bearded man in a patterned fedora wears a gray peacoat over a plaid shirt and tan trousers, one hand in his pocket. Lighting is soft and even, with a casual editorial band-portrait look.
